blurb: Located on 10 acres just 40 minutes north of Austin. Northwest of Georgetown and close to Sun City Georgetown. South of Salado and Killeen. The closest major intersection is Hwy 195 and FM 487 in Florence, Texas. We have large oak trees on the property and plenty of greenspace. Total of 12 RV sites, 1 cabin and main house on property.
